grid: 5 cols x 228 px square cells, 10 frames, see art/spells.js SHEET
colour_en: hot crimson 0xff3a5a with a 0xffd9e2 core, to agree with the drawn gashes, the shout and the wave the same beat already throws
colour_zh: 深红 0xff3a5a，核心 0xffd9e2，与同一拍已有的手绘爪痕、喊话和冲击波保持一致
prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic, high contrast, saturated colour with a bright white-hot core, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot and the silhouette and edge shape from the claw-mark references; do not copy their backgrounds, their white paper, their colours, their board, their gems, their characters or any part of their layout. Three parallel claw slashes tear diagonally across the frame from the upper right down to the lower left, and all three open at the very same instant, together, in one single beat: one strike, not three. They arrive on the same frame, none of them lagging behind another, never one after another, never three separate attacks. It reads as one hand going through because of how each gash tears, not because of any delay between them. Each slash opens from nothing and rips along its own length: a tapered gash, widest about a third of the way along and coming to a fine point at both ends, its edges ragged and torn with small hooks and splinters coming off them, never a smooth stripe, never a rounded bar, never a straight line. The middle slash is the longest and cuts the deepest, the two outside it are shorter and sit parallel to it and evenly spaced. Each gash is a hot crimson red wound with a thin white-hot core burning down the middle of its length, throwing small sparks and flecks of molten light off its torn edges, and a faint red heat glow sits just around all three as if the air itself had been opened. They flare to their brightest the instant they finish opening, hold for a moment, then burn down and fade from the tips inward until nothing is left. There is exactly one swipe in the whole clip, landing on one beat: no second strike, no repeat, no further set of slashes after it, nothing else happening before or after it, and it is finished well before the clip ends. The effect is alone on a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green studio backdrop — a seamless green studio cyclorama, the same solid green from edge to edge, and nothing else is in frame: no floor, no room, no landscape, no wall, no rock, no creature, no monster, no claws, no hand, no arm, no character, no smoke, no dust, no haze, no atmospheric glow, no shadow cast on the green. The green is a plain backdrop and is never lit by the effect: it does not brighten, glow, flicker, darken or change colour anywhere, not even directly behind a slash, and no green light spills onto the slashes, which stay crimson and white-hot and are never tinted green. The three slashes stay centred and fill the frame corner to corner and are never cropped by the edges. Square frame. Single continuous shot, one fixed locked-off camera, no cuts, no shot changes, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Clean high-contrast green-screen VFX plate for chroma keying, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no UI.
prompt_zh: 严格匹配参考游戏截图的美术风格：手绘风格的 3D 手游 RPG 美术，半写实，高对比，饱和的颜色配炽白的核心，不要扁平的卡通着色，不要动漫线稿，不要像素风。只从那张截图里取渲染风格，只从爪痕参考图里取轮廓与边缘形状；不要照搬它们的背景、白纸、配色、棋盘、宝石、角色或任何排版。三道平行的爪痕沿对角线撕开画面，从右上方划向左下方，三道在同一瞬间一起裂开，同一拍完成，是同一次挥爪：它们同时出现，没有先后，绝不是一道接一道，也绝不是三次分开的攻击。之所以读起来像一只手抓过去，靠的是每一道沿着自身的长度撕开，而不是靠彼此之间的时间差。每一道都从无到有地裂开，并沿着自身的长度撕开：一道两头收尖的伤口，大约在三分之一处最宽，两端都收成细尖，边缘粗糙撕裂、带着细小的倒钩与毛刺，绝不是光滑的条带，绝不是圆角的长条，绝不是笔直的直线。中间那道最长、最深，两侧的两道略短，与它平行且间距均匀。每一道都是炽热的深红色伤口，正中有一条细而炽白的核心在燃烧，撕裂的边缘不断抛出细小的火星和熔融光点；三道的紧邻四周还有一层淡淡的红色热辉，仿佛空气本身被撕开。它们在裂开完成的瞬间亮到最强，短暂停留，然后从尖端向内燃尽、淡去，直到什么也不剩。整段片子里只有这一次挥爪，一拍完成：没有第二次挥击，没有重复，之后也不会再出现另一组爪痕，前后也没有别的动作，并且在片子结束之前很早就已经完成。特效单独出现在一块平整、打光均匀的抠像绿幕影棚背景前——无缝的绿色影棚背景，从边缘到边缘都是同一种纯绿色，画面里没有别的东西：没有地面、没有房间、没有风景、没有墙壁、没有岩石、没有生物、没有怪物、没有爪子、没有手、没有手臂、没有角色，没有烟雾、没有尘土、没有雾气、没有大气辉光，绿幕上也没有投影。绿幕只是背景板，绝不被特效照亮：任何位置都不会变亮、发光、闪烁、变暗或改变颜色，即使正对着爪痕的背后也不会；绿光也绝不溢到爪痕上，爪痕始终是深红与炽白色，绝不被染上绿色。三道爪痕始终居中，从一角铺到另一角，绝不被画面边缘裁切。方形画幅。单镜头一镜到底，固定机位，无剪辑、无场景切换、无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。干净的高对比绿幕抠像特效素材，无文字、无字母、无数字、无水印、无标志、无 UI。

references_en: 1. the game screenshot — STYLE ONLY: rendering, palette, contrast, how light is painted. Never its board, gems, cards, boss or layout.
2. the black claw marks on white — SILHOUETTE ONLY: three tapered gashes, ragged edges, pointed both ends. Never its white background.
3. the red/teal claw VFX renders — the look of a lit gash: hot core, sparks off the torn edge. Take the crimson, not the teal.

2. 白底黑爪痕 —— 只取轮廓：三道两头收尖的伤口，边缘粗糙，两端收尖。绝不取它的白色背景。
3. 红色/青色爪痕特效图 —— 发光伤口的质感：炽热的核心、撕裂边缘抛出的火星。取其中的深红，不要青色。
